title: anerp: an agent-native headless ERP kernel (v0.2.0, evaluation matrix)
description: A headless ERP kernel whose only public surface is typed business-operation tools over MCP and a task-level agent over A2A; every write is two-phase, idempotent, receipted, policy-checked and event-emitting on one double-entry ledger. This release includes the evaluation harness and the tier-matched results matrix (claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5.6-terra, gemini-3.8-flash; agent-native vs CRUD tool surface; 20 tasks x 3 runs), with the reproducibility appendix REPRODUCIBILITY.md.
